raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 17
Reason for Mistake: The Planner inverted the verified release dates between the two films when synthesizing the results. IMDb Release info showed My Wife's Lodger first released in the UK in October 1952 and Tiger of the Seven Seas first released in Italy on December 23, 1962. The Planner mistakenly swapped these (claiming My Wife's Lodger was 1962 and Tiger was 1952), leading to the incorrect conclusion that Tiger of the Seven Seas was released earlier. This is a logical consistency/error-in-mapping issue, not a sourcing problem.
